Current Problem: Every request loads the admin and the company from the DB (2 queries) before the handler
Why It Matters: Doubles DB load on every API call; cached list endpoints still take ~30 ms
Suggested Change: Cache admin tokenVersion/isActive and company status in Redis for 30-60 s; invalidate on change

Current Problem: Each module re-implements list/item cache keys; invalidation is manual and was missed for candidate documents
Why It Matters: Stale data bugs (candidate documents) and repeated code in 20 modules
Suggested Change: One generic cache helper keyed by entity + tenant with tag-based invalidation

Current Problem: Token issuing and verification copied in three auth services
Why It Matters: Fixes (e.g. revocation) must be done three times
Suggested Change: Extract a TokenService used by admin, centre and candidate auth

Current Problem: Three global guards repeat the same reflector checks and all run on every request
Why It Matters: Hard to reason about which guard protects what
Suggested Change: One AuthGuard that picks the strategy from metadata

Current Problem: assertPayloadRelations checks language and difficulty one by one in a loop (N+1)
Why It Matters: A 3-language question with 4 children runs ~30 queries
Suggested Change: Collect ids and check with one IN query per table

Current Problem: List loads category, instruction and template relations for every row; limit=200 response took 178 ms avg
Why It Matters: Large payloads for the list screen
Suggested Change: Select only list columns + names via join

Current Problem: MAX(SUBSTRING(...)) scan for every new code
Create/Update DTOs are copied by hand instead of PartialType(OmitType(...))
Why It Matters: Rules drift between create and update (e.g. empty firstName allowed on update)
Suggested Change: Derive update DTOs with PartialType and keep extra rules in one place

Current Problem: Some modules use softDeleteIfExists, others write update({deletedAt}) by hand (sessions, test-candidate-mappings)
Why It Matters: Inconsistent soft delete (isActive not cleared in some)

Current Problem: Some controllers wrap with apiSuccess, others return the service's ApiResponse; mixed patterns
Suggested Change: Return data from services; wrap in controllers or interceptor only

Current Problem: Large service mixes caching, locking, mapping and queries
Suggested Change: Split paper builder, details builder and cache/lock helper

Why It Matters: Turns 'false' into true and numbers into strings

Current Problem: Env values are read without validation or defaults
Max year is computed once at startup
Why It Matters: After New Year the limit is wrong until restart
Suggested Change: Custom validator computing the year per request
